original_value: A fictional quartz wrist unit for everyday timekeeping, featuring a compact resin case, luminous analog dial, and splash-resistant construction. Designed as a fashion accessory rather than a computing or storage device, it pairs a minimalist face with a coin-cell battery and adjustable nylon strap.
